description.value: Municipal campground in Centennial Park on the eastern shore of Slocan Lake in the small Kootenay village of New Denver, offering swimming, Selkirk Mountain scenery, and the historic Nikkei Internment Memorial Centre within walking distance. Online reservations are required; a natural anchor stop for cyclists riding the Slocan Valley.

address.value: 115 Slocan Avenue, PO Box 40, New Denver, BC V0G 1S0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM identifies this as a 49-site municipal campsite (tourism=camp_site, reservation=yes, fee=yes) operated by the Village of New Denver. The website at newdenver.ca/campground-2/ confirms the campground is open and that all reservations must be made online, corroborating the OSM reservation tag; it also provides the Village Office contact details (phone 250 358 2316, address 115 Slocan Avenue). The fetched subpages do not describe individual amenities such as showers, potable water, or electrical hookups, so most optional amenities remain null.
concerns: The address on the website (115 Slocan Avenue, PO Box 40, New Denver, BC V0G 1S0) is the Village of New Denver office address, not a distinct campground street address; OSM has no address field to compare against.
Phone (250 358 2316) is the Village Office number sourced from the website; OSM has no phone field, so contact_confirmed.phone is set to null rather than true.
The general campground information subpage was truncated in the fetch, potentially omitting amenity details such as showers, potable water, electrical hookups, or bike-specific facilities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, currently-open 49-site municipal campground in the Kootenays with confirmed online reservations; a useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on the Slocan Lake corridor.
